title: Understanding Statements
description: This question type requires you to determine whether a statement agrees with the passage, contradicts it, or is not mentioned at all.
skill_tested: Identifying factual information and distinguishing stated, contradicted, and missing information.
common_tip: Never assume information. Base every answer only on what is written in the passage.

title: Recognizing Writer's Opinion
description: This question type focuses on identifying the writer's opinions, beliefs, or claims rather than simple facts.
common_tip: Pay attention to opinion words and avoid using your own knowledge.

title: Finding Main Ideas
description: You must choose the most appropriate heading for each paragraph based on its main idea.
skill_tested: Identifying main ideas and paragraph organization.
common_tip: Read the entire paragraph before selecting the heading.

title: Locating Specific Details
description: You need to identify the paragraph containing specific information.
common_tip: Use keywords from the question and look for synonyms in the passage.

title: Selecting the Best Answer
description: Choose the correct answer from several options using information from the passage.
common_tip: Eliminate incorrect options before choosing the best answer.

title: Completing Sentences
description: Complete sentences using words from the reading passage.
common_tip: Follow the word limit and ensure grammatical accuracy.

title: Completing Summaries
description: Fill missing words in a summary using information from the passage.
common_tip: Look for synonyms and paraphrases instead of identical words.

title: Answering Direct Questions
description: Answer questions using words taken directly from the passage.
common_tip: Keep answers within the required word limit.

title: Completing Tables
description: Complete missing information in a table based on the reading passage.
common_tip: Understand how the table is structured before searching for answers.

title: Understanding Processes
description: Complete a flow chart using information from the passage.
common_tip: Pay attention to transition words such as first, next, then, and finally.

title: Labeling Diagrams
description: Identify the correct labels for parts of a diagram using the passage.
skill_tested: Connecting textual descriptions with visual information.
common_tip: Study both the diagram and the relevant paragraph carefully before answering.

title: Matching Characteristics
description: Match statements or features with the correct people, places, or items.
common_tip: Check each option carefully because some may be used more than once.

title: Completing Ideas
description: Choose the correct ending to complete a sentence logically.
common_tip: Read both halves carefully before making your choice.
